Message: Click handler calls Exchange/AD directly with no try/catch. An exception here is caught by .NET, not PowerShell, and the operator sees assembly versions instead of a line number. JUDGEMENT: a handler that delegates to a function which catches its own errors is fine -- check where the call goes before adding a try here.
